text:
Alex: Pushed a Terraform change proposal to diversify GPU spot pools — mix AMD-backed instances with our existing NVIDIA pool to reduce interruption tail events. planning to canary in us-west-2-staging. :eyes:

Priya: nice. which instance families are you mixing? any weight policy?

Alex: g5.2xlarge, g5a.2xlarge (AMD), and g4dn.xlarge for cheap fallback. using mixed_instances_policy with weighted_capacity. allocation_strategy = "capacity-optimized" for spot.

Jon: can you paste the tf snippet? want to see weights and tags for autoscaler.

Alex: sure: ```hcl
resource "aws_autoscaling_group" "gpu_pool" {
  mixed_instances_policy {
    launch_template { launch_template_specification { id = aws_launch_template.gpu.id } }
    instances_distribution { on_demand_base_capacity = 0 on_demand_percentage_above_base_capacity = 10 spot_allocation_strategy = "capacity-optimized" }
    launch_template { override { instance_type = "g5.2xlarge" weighted_capacity = "2" } override { instance_type = "g5a.2xlarge" weighted_capacity = "2" } override { instance_type = "g4dn.xlarge" weighted_capacity = "1" } }
  tags = [{ key = "k8s.io/cluster-autoscaler/enabled" value = "true" propagate_at_launch = true }]
}
```

Maya: make sure AMI drivers are compatible across families. staging AMI image needs both NVIDIA and AMD kernel blobs or build separate launch templates with same user-data.

Alex: plan is separate launch templates sharing same ASG via overrides; user-data will detect type and load correct drivers. also added spot interruption handler via SQS/instance metadata to gracefully drain pods.

Priya: add a tf var to toggle "fallback_to_on_demand" for the rollout. we should have a policy: if sustained spot failures > 15min, autoscaler scales on-demand up to X.

Alex: added `fallback_to_on_demand = true` and `on_demand_percentage_above_base_capacity = 10` in the distribution. deploy-bot: ran `terraform plan` and returned OK for staging.

deploy-bot: infra-ci/plan-report: success. plan changes: +1 launch_template, +1 asg, modifications to autoscaling policies.

Jon: schedule a 10% canary to start (label: gpu-mix-canary) and watch eviction counts + pod restart latency. set alert if node eviction > 2% over 10m.

Maya: we'll also capture kernel msg failures in node exporter and attach to the rollout dashboard.

Alex: rolling this out to us-west-2-staging tomorrow 09:30 PT. tagging for cost center: cost_center=platform-gpu and rollout=heterogeneous-2026. notes in PR about rollback: revert to prior launch_template and set on_demand_percentage_above_base_capacity=100 if things go sideways. :thumbsup:

Priya: great. I'll own monitoring and rollback runbook.

infra-ci: merged terraform branch to staging (apply deferred).
